summary:
Added Camera Cloud Service, supporting uploading camera files to cloud storage. The supported cloud services vary depending on country/region and mobile device type. Currently supported services include Google Drive, OneDrive, and the user's own NAS. Supported services may be adjusted in future updates.
Added joystick support for 45° diagonal gimbal movement.
Updated the D-Log to Rec.709 and D-Log to Rec.709 vivid LUT files to v2.0, improving the accuracy and consistency of color reproduction.
Added a D-Log 10-bit color mode for slow motion. It is recommended to use with the updated v2.0 LUT files.
Optimized the interaction experience and image quality in certain scenarios.
Fixed some known issues.
